title: On-demand tailoring: out-of-graph, the {{green:human}} owns the decision
headSub: ADR-055/059/061. The workflow runs end to end with no interrupt(). Tailoring is triggered per job AFTER the run completes; the Fidelity Reviewer always runs, and the only gate is the human decision, validated server-side before it persists.

takeaway.text: Gate the irreversible, not everything. Tailoring is repeatable and post-hoc, so it runs {{amber:out of graph}} with no interrupt(); the only HITL is the {{green:human decision}} on the draft, validated before it persists.
